text:
marta: Following the RCA, we need clear ownership and a repeatable handoff for the action list. Rather than 'sherpa', proposing a rotating 'relay lead' model + a 'tie-breaker' owner who can take over mid-week. Starter tickets: RW-4011, RW-4012, RW-4019. Who can take relay for week A?
natasha: I can take week A. I'll pick up RW-4011 (kv eviction tuning) and RW-4019 (dashboard noise).
owen: I'll be secondary on RW-4012 (alert threshold tuning). Happy to be tie-breaker if Natasha is out.
kevin: Natasha please add a short Acceptance Criteria (AC) and a rollback plan in each ticket. Example AC: RW-4011 -> "95th p95 reduced by >=20% in 24h window OR rollback flag applied within 30m".
priya: Also include a concrete post-deploy verification snippet. E.g., in the ticket include:```
SELECT count(*) FROM errors WHERE env='prod' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```as the smoke check and expected thresholds.
natasha: Adding ACs + rollback section now. ETA for initial change: Fri EOD. I'll include the SQL smoke check and a list of dashboards to watch.
oncall-bot: Reminder: PM action checklist due in 2 days for postmortem 2024-06-22.
marta: I'll add RACI to the PM doc: R=Relay Lead (natasha), A=PM (marta), C=EngSRE+Observability, I=Platform & Support. Tie-breaker=owen for week A. Any objections?
owen: fine by me. Can we also add a small 'handoff token' section in the ticket that has two fields: current_relay and next_relay? That makes programmatic checks trivial.
kevin: +1. Also tag tickets with `repeat-pattern` if this looks like a recurrence of the April cache spike.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-4100: "Relay-run remediation sprint - cycle A" and linked RW-4011, RW-4012, RW-4019.
marta: Great. Natasha once the tickets have AC + smoke tests, paste the links here and I'll attach them to the postmortem and set sprint labels for ops reporting.
natasha: Done: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4011 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4012 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4019. ACs, rollback steps, smoke checks, and handoff_token fields added.
priya: Quick question on RW-4011 mitigation: will we start with a config toggle or a staged code push?
natasha: Config toggle first (can toggle off instantly). Code push only if telemetry shows no improvement after 48h. Documented in RW-4011.
kevin: I'll reserve one EngSRE cycle to validate the toggle in staging and run the smoke script overnight.
marta: Schedule: daily 10m sync for relay week, wrap-up on Fri 2pm with PM. Kevin please be ready to run the verification runbook. If relay is blocked, tie-breaker takes over and updates `current_relay` in the ticket. Closing loop here, thanks all. :white_check_mark:
